# VehicleController

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("VehicleController")`

Makes the part it is under a vehicle's chassis, held up by the `VehicleWheel`s under it and driven by an engine through a gearbox. Each wheel is a suspension and a tire. Set `Throttle`, `Steer`, `Brake` and `HandBrake` each frame, from a script or an input action, to drive it.

The chassis must be unanchored. A wheel is not a part of the simulation: it is a cast from the chassis down to the ground, so it rolls over a curb a wheel part would bounce off. Give each wheel a `WheelPart` to see it turn and roll. Forward is the chassis' `LookVector`.

It runs on the server, in the simulation, and is replicated as the chassis is.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

In a match, the server sets it, and the driver's own machine predicts the vehicle as it predicts their character, so the car answers the wheel at once. |
